$$
F(t)-L(t).
$$

Its order rate is $O(t)=190t e^{-0.1t}$ cars per hour and its completion rate is $C(t)=30+20\sin(2\pi t/6)$ cars per hour, where $t$ is hours after work begins. What is the rate of change in the number of cars under construction at the 24-hour time $12\text{:}30$? Orders enter construction immediately. Round your answer to the nearest integer.
question.:question/worked-solution:
The rate of change is the order rate minus the completion rate. The elapsed time is $t=(750-480)/60=4.5$ hours.

$$
\begin{aligned}O(4.5)-C(4.5) & =190(4.5){e}^{-0.1(4.5)}-(30+20\sin(\frac{2\pi }{6}(4.5))) \\  & =190(4.5){e}^{-0.45}-30-20\sin(\frac{3 \pi}{2}) \\  & =190(4.5){e}^{-0.45}-10 \\  & \approx 535.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the rate of change is $535$ cars per hour.
